bill.title: To require the Secretary of Education to issue guidance regarding seizure safety in elementary schools and secondary schools, and for other purposes.
bill.latestActionText: Referred to the House Committee on Education and Workforce.

classification.plainSummary: This bill would require the Secretary of Education to issue guidance to elementary and secondary schools on seizure safety protocols. The guidance would help schools develop procedures for recognizing and responding to seizures among students. The bill does not specify enforcement mechanisms or funding levels.

industries.rationale: The bill directly imposes new guidance requirements on elementary and secondary schools regarding seizure safety protocols.
Schools may need to coordinate with healthcare providers to develop and implement seizure response protocols.

disclaimer: This tool places two public records next to each other: who donated to a member of Congress, and what that member legislated on. Any overlap you see is a correlation, not causation. It is not evidence of a quid pro quo, of influence, or of wrongdoing. Legislators routinely receive support from industries in their district for the same reason they legislate on them: those industries are there.
